name: proof-block
title: Proof block
description: The site's proof section: a White lead line centered over the proof marquee of marks, 40px apart, with the section's padding under it; it follows a hero or a page head.
use_for: Under a hero or a page head, to show who uses the product, with marks you are allowed to show.
never: Third-party logos without permission: the default marks are Acme wordmarks
A section head in place of the lead line
source: Site v3/V3Proof (V3Proof.tsx, V3Proof.module.css): .section with no top padding, a 40px gap, .t-lead at the regular weight in --text, the ProofStrip under it with the logos twice per copy (stripLogos), .t-lead's measure and pretty wrap
